source: Butterfly published specifications (butterflyonline.com blade/rubber specification pages and product pages), retrieved 2026-11-09. Blade weight, head thickness, reaction and vibration are Butterfly's published values; rubber speed, spin, arc and hardness are Butterfly's published 0-100 values. Rubber weight is not published as text, so total weight is blade weight only. DHS and Nittaku entries come from tabletennisstore.us product pages (speed/spin/control on a 0-100 scale as listed there, retrieved 2026-11-09); the shop is a retailer, not the maker, and does not always state the scale or weights, so those values are approximate. Items without grams listed have weightG null. Hardness is null where the shop lists none. Yasaka, Stiga, XIOM, 729, JOOLA, Donic, Andro and Tibhar entries come from the same retailer (tabletennisstore.us), retrieved 2026-11-09. Hardness given as a range (Yasaka) is the midpoint; descriptive-only hardness is null. Items lacking numeric speed/control ratings were left out (all XIOM and JOOLA blades, 729 Battle II, JOOLA Dynaryz ACC and Trinity Dynamic). JOOLA control is the shop's Precision value; JOOLA Dynaryz ZGR spin 10.5 of 10 is capped at 100; 729 Focus III Snipe ratings are converted from a /15 scale; Tibhar MX-P control listed as 67/10 is treated as 67. Weights without a stated unit of grams are null. Victas, TSP and GEWO added from the same retailer; only items with numeric ratings on a 0-100 style scale were kept (TSP 730 rated out of 10 and converted; GEWO Neoflexx eFT 45 spin listed as 110 is capped at 100; GEWO's other rubbers use a different scale above 100 and were left out). Approximate weights marked ca./~ are used as grams. Palio, Sanwei and Killerspin, plus extra XIOM, JOOLA and Victas blades, come from RevSpin (revspin.net, retrieved 2026-11-09), whose speed, spin and control are community averages on a 1-10 scale shown here as x10 (only items with at least 8 ratings were used). RevSpin blade weights, thicknesses and plies are as listed there; conflicting weights were left blank. These community ratings are not directly comparable to the shop and maker ratings used for other brands. Yinhe (Galaxy/Milkyway) and Yasaka Mark V come from RevSpin community ratings (x10). Butterfly Dignics 05/09C, Tenergy 19 and four more Butterfly blades use Butterfly's published figures; their photos load from RevSpin. These items were added because they appear on RevSpin's most-used lists (retrieved 2026-11-09), which every brand in this catalog was checked against. Four blades without a loadable photo (XIOM Vega Tour, JOOLA Rossi Emotion, Victas Koki Niwa Wood, Sanwei V5 Pro) were replaced or dropped; JOOLA Viva and Vyzaryz Trinity were added from RevSpin. 729 Bomb blade added from RevSpin (43 community ratings). The Butterfly ALC blades come from Butterfly's blade specification table (weight, head thickness, reaction, vibration); photos load from RevSpin, and Innerforce Layer ALC.S has none.
